_doc: Monster stats at stage 1 (stage scaling comes in phase 3). behaviour: chase | swarm | charge | boss_slime (winds up, jumps to where the player was, slam on landing; split_at fractions of hp spawn split_count split_into). boss: true = HUD bar, the stage is won when it dies. body circle (contact, being hit) comes from the sprite json 'body', not from here. xp = gem value. See design/monsters.md.
